name: poteto-mode
description: Rigorous agent mode adapted from Cursor's pstack: /poteto-mode matches a playbook, builds a todo list, delegates by model tier, and demands evidence before reporting done.

commands.name: poteto-mode
commands.description: Rigorous mode: playbook, todo list, tiered sub-agents, evidence before done

commands.name: how
commands.description: Walk through how a subsystem works, from real code, before touching it

commands.name: why
commands.description: Explain why something was built this way, from git history and ADRs

commands.name: architect
commands.description: Design a change that crosses a boundary: data shapes first, callers second, code last

commands.name: arena
commands.description: Run N parallel attempts at the same task in isolation and pick the winner with evidence

commands.name: interrogate
commands.description: Adversarial review by independent sub-agents; only confirmed findings survive

commands.name: tdd
commands.description: Fix a bug or add behavior by writing the failing test first, then the smallest fix

commands.name: figure-it-out
commands.description: Design a bespoke plan with measurable finish conditions for work no playbook covers

commands.name: show-me-your-work
commands.description: Write the decision log for the current task: what was tried, what was rejected, and why

commands.name: unslop
commands.description: Strip filler from prose or code: shorter sentences, fewer comments, no defensive noise
